name: Pomme d’ ambre (Apple of Amber)
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 4th; Slot —; Price 1,500 gp; Weight 1/8 lb.

DESCRIPTION

About Magic Perfumes Magic perfumes act as other perfumes. They last for 4 hours and make it easier for creatures with scent to notice or track you. Their effects operate in an aura of 10 ft. (or 5 ft. outdoors) centered on you. Detect magic reveals the aura.

This pomander resembles a silver apple. When worn on a chain around your neck and loaded with perfume, it grants a +2 resistance bonus to Fortitude saves against disease.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells resistance; Cost 750 gp
